Screen 1 – Onboarding Welcome (Visual Spec)
Concept Snapshot
A dark, immersive sports cosmos where Lahore’s night turf meets sci-fi UI.
The user lands in a neon stadium aura with a glowing orb that quietly says:
“This is where all your games start.”
________________


1. Visual Walkthrough (What You See, Top → Bottom)
1. Status & Background
* Background:

   * Full-screen vertical gradient: deep midnight navy (#020617) at the top, drifting into a slightly brighter teal-indigo mix at the bottom.

   * Overlaid with very soft diagonal light streaks, like stadium floodlights blurred far in the distance.

   * Tiny particles (faint dots) slowly drifting—barely noticeable but give depth.

      * Status bar:

         * Light icons (battery, network, time) in white, sitting cleanly over the gradient.

________________


2. Brand & Tagline Block (Top Center)
            * At the top center:

Logo

               * Pay2Play wordmark in white + neon accent (e.g., the “2” or “Play” glowing slightly).

                  * Primary tagline (one line, big and clean):

                     * “Pay less. Play more.”

                        * Secondary line (smaller, right below):

                           * “Book a pitch in under 60 seconds.”

                              * Visual feeling:

                                 * Fonts are sharp, humanist sans-serif, not too techy, not too playful. Think “sports-tech fintech.”

________________


3. Hero Orb & Icons (Centerpiece)
This is the soul of the screen.
                                    * In the center, occupying ~40% of the screen height:

                                       * A glowing circular orb (~240–280px) with:

                                          * Subtle inner gradient (teal → electric green → cobalt).

                                          * Soft blur glow around it, like a light source on dark glass.

                                             * Around it:

                                                * Three icons slowly orbit, on very subtle paths:

                                                   * Cricket bat/ball icon.

                                                   * Football icon.

                                                   * Padel racket/ball icon.

                                                      * Each icon has a thin neon stroke halo, like a HUD marker.

                                                         * Behind the orb:

                                                            * A faint suggestion of a pitch outline (five-a-side pitch lines or cricket field arcs) in ultra-low opacity, almost like AR overlays.

Emotion: “You’re looking at the hub where every sport you play is connected.”
________________


4. Value Pill Row (Below Orb)
                                                               * Right under the hero, three horizontal glass pills sit in a row (or 2 + 1 stacked on small screens).

Each pill:
                                                                  * Shape: Rounded-xxl rectangle with glassmorphism:

                                                                     * Background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6) (dark slate with translucency).

                                                                     * Border: 1px subtle, rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.5).

                                                                     * Soft inner shadow / glow.

                                                                        * Inside each pill:

                                                                           * Left: minimalist icon (outline style).

                                                                           * Right: short label.

Pills (left → right):
                                                                              1. Shield icon

                                                                                 * Text: Vetted venues

                                                                                    2. Clock/bolt icon

                                                                                       * Text: Real-time slots

                                                                                          3. Tag/price icon

                                                                                             * Text: Live discounts

They slide up with a gentle staggered animation when the screen appears.
________________


5. Primary Call-to-Action Block
Centered, with generous breathing room.
                                                                                                * Primary Button – “Get Started”

                                                                                                   * Full-width (with side margins).

                                                                                                   * Height ~52px.

                                                                                                   * Rounded-2xl.

                                                                                                   * Gradient fill: teal → electric green.

                                                                                                   * Slight outer glow and drop shadow.

                                                                                                   * Label in bold white, maybe with a tiny right-arrow icon or phone icon.

                                                                                                      * Directly under the button (small, muted text):

                                                                                                         * “Continue with your phone number”

                                                                                                            * Secondary Action – “Explore first”

                                                                                                               * Outlined / ghost button beneath primary (or just text link).

                                                                                                               * Border and label in soft teal/indigo.

                                                                                                               * Text: “Explore first (no signup)” or simply “Explore first”.

This gives an MVP option: you can later decide whether “Explore first” is just a teaser or fully implemented guest mode.
________________


6. Bottom Meta Block (Login + Legal)
Anchored to the bottom safe area.
                                                                                                                  * Login hint:

                                                                                                                     * Centered small text:

                                                                                                                        * “Already playing with Pay2Play?”

Next to it, tappable link in accent color: “Log in”.

                                                                                                                           * Legal line (smallest text on screen):

                                                                                                                              * “By continuing, you agree to our Terms and Privacy Policy.”

                                                                                                                              * “Terms” and “Privacy Policy” are tappable, underlined in subtle accent color.

________________


________________

3. Component Mapping (Quick Recap)
From this visualization, the reusable components you’ll want in your design system / code:
                                                                                                                                       * Layout

                                                                                                                                          * ScreenBackground (gradient + optional particles)

                                                                                                                                          * ScreenContainer (safe-area, padding)

                                                                                                                                             * UI Components

                                                                                                                                                * AppLogoHeader – logo + primary/secondary tagline.

                                                                                                                                                * HeroOrb – animated orb + orbiting icons.

                                                                                                                                                * FeaturePill – icon + label, glass style.

                                                                                                                                                * PrimaryButton – gradient, full-width.

                                                                                                                                                * SecondaryButton / GhostButton – outlined/text.

                                                                                                                                                * BottomMeta – login prompt + legal line.

Alright, jumping into Screen 2: Phone Verification + Basic Info Setup 👟📲
I’ll treat this as one flow with three tight steps that feel like a single, continuous experience:
                                                                                                                                                   * 2A – Phone Entry

                                                                                                                                                   * 2B – OTP Verification

                                                                                                                                                   * 2C – Basic Info Setup (Name, Avatar, Sports)

All of this keeps the same futuristic neon-sports cosmos from Screen 1.
________________


Screen 2A – Phone Entry
Concept Snapshot
You’ve tapped “Get Started”. The camera zooms metaphorically closer to the orb.
The UI shifts from “inspiration” to “identity”: “Who’s stepping on the pitch?”
Visual Walkthrough (Top → Bottom)
Background & Overall Feel
                                                                                                                                                      * Same dark gradient as Screen 1 for continuity.

                                                                                                                                                      * The hero orb is now smaller and shifted slightly upward, like it’s making space for a card in the foreground.

                                                                                                                                                      * The vibe: “You’re entering the control room to your sports life.”

________________
________________


Layout
+------------------------------------------------------+
| [ STATUS BAR ]                                       |
+------------------------------------------------------+
| [ Back chevron ]       Pay2Play logo (small)         |
|                                                      |
|  Title:   "Let’s get your number"                    |
|  Subtitle:"We’ll use it to secure your bookings."    |
|                                                      |
|  [ Glass card ]                                      |
|   +----------------------------------------------+   |
|   |  Label: Phone number                         |   |
|   |  [  +92  |  __ __ __ __ __ __ __ __ __  ]    |   |
|   |  Hint: "WhatsApp number works best."         |   |
|   |  [ Small info icon: 'We never spam.' ]       |   |
|   +----------------------------------------------+   |
|                                                      |
|   [ CONTINUE (Primary button) ]                      |
|   Text: "We’ll send you a one-time code."            |

|                                                      |
+------------------------------------------------------+
|   "By continuing, you agree to our Terms & Privacy"  |
+------------------------------------------------------+
________________


Key Visual Details
                                                                                                                                                         * Header row:

                                                                                                                                                            * Left: back chevron “‹” (go back to Welcome).

                                                                                                                                                            * Center/right: small Pay2Play logo, anchored top for brand continuity.

                                                                                                                                                               * Title & subtitle:

                                                                                                                                                                  * Title: “Let’s get your number”

                                                                                                                                                                  * Subtitle in muted color: “We’ll use it to secure your bookings.”

                                                                                                                                                                     * Glass card for input:

                                                                                                                                                                        * Card sits in the center, width ~90% frame.

                                                                                                                                                                        * Background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.75) with blur.

                                                                                                                                                                        * Border: soft 1px accent, teal/indigo.

                                                                                                                                                                        * Inside:

                                                                                                                                                                           * Label: “Phone number”

                                                                                                                                                                           * Country code dropdown: +92 pill on left.

                                                                                                                                                                           * Large single-line input for the rest of the number.

                                                                                                                                                                           * Beneath, small hint “WhatsApp number works best.” and a “shield” icon with “We never spam.”

                                                                                                                                                                              * CTA button:

                                                                                                                                                                                 * Primary Button: “Continue”

                                                                                                                                                                                 * Under text: “We’ll send you a one-time code.”

                                                                                                                                                                                    * Secondary helpers:

                                                                                                                                                                                       * Text link: “Having trouble? Chat with us” (future in-app support or WhatsApp link).

Screen 2B – OTP Verification
Upon pressing “Continue”:
The orb pulses once softly, as if sending a signal.
The screen transforms into a code entry state.
Layout
+------------------------------------------------------+
| [ STATUS BAR ]                                       |
+------------------------------------------------------+
| [ Back chevron ]    +92 XXX-XXXXXXX (small text)     |
|                                                      |
|  Title:   "Enter the 6-digit code"                   |
|  Subtitle:"We’ve sent it to +92 XXX-XXXXXXX"         |
|                                                      |
|  [   _   _   _   _   _   _   ]  (OTP boxes)          |
|                                                      |
|      [  Resend code in 00:34  ]                      |
|      [  Change number  ]                             |
|                                                      |
|  [ VERIFY & CONTINUE (Primary button) ]              |
|                                                      |
+------------------------------------------------------+
|  "Secure, OTP-based login. No passwords to forget."  |
+------------------------------------------------------+
________________


Visual Details
                                                                                                                                                                                          * Background & orb remain, but orb is dimmed behind a frosted pane to draw attention to the OTP.

                                                                                                                                                                                          * OTP input:

                                                                                                                                                                                             * Six rounded boxes in a row.

                                                                                                                                                                                             * Each box is slightly glassy; active one glows with teal border.

                                                                                                                                                                                             * On focus, a floating numeric keyboard appears (mobile default).

                                                                                                                                                                                                * Timer & options:

                                                                                                                                                                                                   * Beneath boxes:

                                                                                                                                                                                                      * “Resend code in 00:34” (countdown).

                                                                                                                                                                                                      * “Change number” as a text button.

                                                                                                                                                                                                         * Primary CTA:

                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Button: “Verify & Continue”

                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Enabled state when all 6 digits filled.

                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Disabled state: lower opacity, no glow.

                                                                                                                                                                                                               * Success animation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * When OTP succeeds:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Orb glows bright for a moment.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Short micro-copy appears: “Great, you’re in!” and transitions to Basic Info step.

Now we shift from “device identity” to “player identity”.
You’re asked: “Who’s actually stepping on the pitch?”

Visual Details
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        * Step indicator:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                           * Top right small text/chip: “Step 2 of 3”

                                                                                                                                                                                                                           * Gives a sense of progression and keeps friction low.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Avatar selection:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * Horizontally scrollable row of rounded avatars (e.g., stylized player headshots, diverse designs).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * The selected avatar has:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * A neon ring outline.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Slight scale-up.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Soft shadow/glow.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       * Name card:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          * Glass card with label and input.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          * Inside:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             * Large text field, placeholder “Your full name”.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             * Example prefill is fine for mocks.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                * Preferred sports chips:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   * Three pill chips for Cricket, Football, Padel.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   * Selected:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      * Filled with teal gradient, white label, tiny icon.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         * Unselected:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Transparent with border only.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               * CTA:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * “Continue”

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Subtext: “Next: your city & time preferences” (or change to “You can change this anytime” if we keep preferences in same screen).

Screen 3 – City & Time Preferences + “What kind of games do you want?”
Concept Snapshot
Screen 1 told them what Pay2Play is.
Screen 2 figured out who they are.
Screen 3 figures out where and how they like to play so the app can feel tailored from day one.
Think of this as a “calibration screen” for matching + venue defaults.
________________


1. Visual Walkthrough (Top → Bottom)
Background & Overall Feel
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Same dark neon sports cosmos:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               * Vertical gradient (#020617 → #0b1120).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               * Soft stadium light streaks.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               * Our orb is now smaller and parked in the top-right corner, like a floating assistant watching over your choices.

________________

2.4 Match Cards (Feed)
Scroll area: stacked cards, each representing a joinable game.
There are two main “types” of cards, but visually consistent:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. Host-led Confirmed Slot (preferred) – linked to a booked venue/slot.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. LFP/LFG Post – a player looking for teammates/opponents, may or may not be linked to a specific venue yet.

Let’s define a unified card layout that hints at the type.
________________


2.4.1 Match Card – Layout

5. Feature Mapping
This screen powers:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Organizers/Host-led Gameplay

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * Listing matches that need extra players.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Player Matching

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       * Defines the metadata that builds the Match cards in the Matches feed:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          * Title, needed players, skill level, cost, notes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             * Venue Integration

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                * Ties match to a confirmed booking (very strong UX: “slot is real, host is serious”).



Let’s make the Match Detail + Join Flow feel like walking into a locker room where everything’s ready and you just say “I’m in.” 🧢⚽
This is:
Screen 10 – Match Detail + Join Flow
Entered from: Matches tab → tap any Match Card.

________________
Screen 10 – Match Detail
Concept Snapshot
Think of it as a game lobby:
You see who’s playing, where & when, how serious it is, and one big decision: Join / Request to join.
Visually it should feel like a holographic match card blown up full-screen with a clear, glowing Join bar at the bottom.
________________

Screen 11 – My Bookings (Upcoming & Past)
Concept Snapshot
Think: flight list for your games.
Clear separation between what’s coming up and what you’ve already played, with easy access to details, venue info, and hosting/chat options.

Screen 13 – Chat Thread (1:1 or Group)
Concept Snapshot
Familiar messaging UI, but with match/booking context pinned at top, and a clean bubble chat with subtle neon accents.
Access:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       * From Match Detail → “Open chat”.

It shows who they are, how they play, and what they’ve earned.
Accessed via bottom tab: Me.

Screen 16 – Event Detail + Registration
Concept Snapshot
This is the tournament poster + signup desk in one screen.
It should answer: What is this event? Where, when, format, fee, rules, and how do I register?
Entry: tap any event/league card.
